name: Kai's first lightsaber
description: Kai's first lightsaber, also known as Kai's lightsaber was a training lightsaber that was wielded by Jedi Initiate Kai Brightstar during the High Republic Era. The saber was a generic brass cylinder design issued for younglings.

data.name: Kai's first lightsaber
data.succeed: Brightstar's second lightsaber (temporarily due to Kai recovering the first and deciding to keep both before returning the second to Yoda)
